name_zh: 曲率误差驱动的查询预算
formal_object: Shape-regular source patches j with area A_j; bounded second derivative kappa_j of the frozen decoder field; n_j interpolation controls with total N.

operations.input: Linear interpolation of a twice-differentiable field
operations.condition: Known derivative bound and shape-regular cells
Two-dimensional surface cells of comparable aspect ratio

operations.input: Minimize sum a_j/n_j^2 at fixed sum n_j=N
operations.condition: Positive bounds and continuous allocation; rounding separately

derivation_steps.statement: Linear interpolation error <=c kappa_j h_j^2 under the stated regularity.
derivation_steps.justification: Taylor's second-order remainder with barycentric linear interpolation.

derivation_steps.statement: Integrated squared bound is <=c' sum kappa_j^2 A_j^3/n_j^2.
derivation_steps.justification: Multiply the pointwise squared bound by area and use h_j^2 proportional to A_j/n_j.

derivation_steps.statement: KKT gives -2 a_j/n_j^3+mu=0, hence n_j=N a_j^(1/3)/sum a^(1/3).
derivation_steps.justification: Convex allocation on n_j>0; a_j=kappa_j^2 A_j^3.

derivation_steps.statement: Integer allocation, mandatory coverage and probe cost change the continuous optimum and require separate accounting.
derivation_steps.justification: No exact bound for rounded controls is implied without checking their cell geometry.

assumptions: Decoder curvature bounds are not supplied by the model; finite differences are estimates. The stated interior allocation uses strictly positive A and kappa; zero-curvature patches and coverage floors require a separate constrained allocation.
Shape regularity and coverage must be verified on the actual anchor mesh.
Sparse interpolation can miss thin parts and correct detailed motion.
Evaluation still emits and scores the full original mesh and times.
method_expression: Allocate a fixed query budget using area and declared curvature estimates, then reconstruct the dense field with a qualified interpolant.
distinguishing_prediction: At matched full query/probe budget, interpolation error should follow local curvature and area, not vertex count alone.
falsifier: Reject new-method investment if historical m07/curvature-aware FPS already implements the same allocation or if uniform/geodesic FPS has the same native cost-quality frontier.
closest_alternative: Classical adaptive finite-element sampling; historical m07 query allocation and STAC curvature-boosted landmarks.
decisive_comparison: Uniform/FPS/curvature-FPS versus the derived allocation, same full cost and native outputs; no dropping scoring points.
operational_delta: A derived allocation exponent and error model; strong functional collision risk makes this reserve, not a claimed new contribution.
feasibility_and_cost: Sparse queries plus derivative probes can cost more than dense native decoding; no speed guarantee without measurement.
structural_signature: Continuous curvature/error budget allocation for decoder interpolation.
algebra_review_basis: Checked surface dimension, squared-error exponent and KKT allocation; approximation, rounding and collision caveats retained.
empirical_status: Not implemented in this round; no native method comparison or outcome.
originality_status: Unadjudicated. Classical tools and historical related code are explicitly attributed.
